2608.01358.title: HopRefusalBench: Diagnosing Refusal Failures in Search-Augmented Agents for Multi-Hop Reasoning
2608.01358.paper_summary: Search-augmented large language model agents are increasingly capable of solving knowledge-intensive tasks, but their behavior when a multi-hop question is fundamentally unanswerable remains poorly understood. Existing abstention benchmarks largely expose defects at the surface of single-hop queries and therefore cannot reveal failures that emerge only after valid intermediate reasoning and retrieval. We introduce HopRefusalBench, the first controlled benchmark of refusal within multi-hop search, comprising 889 unanswerable questions constructed from KILT-grounded entity paths. It crosses three causes of unanswerability (answer unknown, false premise, and underspecified context) with root, middle, and terminal topologies, making premise verification, intermediate-bridge validation, and terminal stopping separately observable. We further propose a final-outcome taxonomy spanning target-aware refusal, pseudo-refusal, hallucinated completion, and search-budget exhaustion, together with source-aware trajectory metrics for post-trigger continuation and token waste. Across ten frontier proprietary and open-weight models in search-augmented mode, the best model achieves a target-aware correct halting rate (TCHR) of only 42.9%. Root and middle items are consistently harder than terminal items, and all models attain their highest TCHR on false premises and their lowest on underspecified questions. Yet when pooled across categories, 84.7--98.4% of each model's explicit refusal-like responses identify the correct rationale, localizing the main bottleneck to committing to an appropriate non-answer; failed trajectories instead diverge into hallucination or search-budget exhaustion. These results establish refusal in multi-hop search as a consequential evaluation problem and provide a foundation for diagnosing and improving the reliability of search-augmented agents.
2608.01358.paper_summary_zh: 搜索增強的大型語言模型代理在解決知識密集型任務方面越來越有能力，但當多跳問題根本無法回答時，它們的行為仍然不甚了解。現有的放棄基準主要暴露了單跳查詢表面上的缺陷，因此無法揭示只有在有效的中間推理和檢索之後才會出現的失敗。我們引入了HopRefusalBench，這是第一個控制的多跳搜索拒絕基準，包括889個無法回答的問題，這些問題是從KILT基礎的實體路徑構建而成。它將三種無法回答的原因（答案未知、錯誤前提和不明確上下文）與根、 中間和終端拓撲交叉，使前提驗證、中間橋接驗證和終端停止可以單獨觀察。我們進一步提出了一個最終結果分類法，涵蓋目標感知拒絕、偽拒絕、幻覺完成和搜索預算耗盡，並結合源感知的軌跡指標，用於觸發後的持續和標記浪費。在十個前沿專有和開放權重模型的搜索增強模式中，最佳模型的目標感知正確停止率（TCHR）僅為42.9%。根和中間項始終比終端項更難，所有模型在錯誤前提上達到最高的TCHR，而在不明確問題上則達到最低。然而，當跨類別匯總時，84.7--98.4%的每個模型的明確拒絕類似反應都識別出正確的理由，將主要瓶頸定位於承諾適當的非答案；失敗的軌跡則轉向幻覺或搜索預算耗盡。這些結果確立了多跳搜索中的拒絕作為一個重要的評估問題，並為診斷和改善搜索增強代理的可靠性提供了基礎。
